The '''power mace''' was a hand weapon that consisted of a large, spherical, striking head, set onto a thin handle. The weapon had a power supply that added an electrical jolt to successful attacks. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] wielded a power mace in [[the Big Game]], a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competition on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The mace proved of little use against Solo's four-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Living windmill|opponent]], but the smuggler bested his adversary regardless.

==Description==
The power mace was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that consisted of a thin handle and a large, spherical striking end, roughly the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] head, covered in long spikes. The mace had an electrical charge that gave the weapon a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] glow and added extra damage to a successful attack; the wielder held the mace in one hand and attempted to hit opponents with its spiky head. At least one model was gray in color.<ref name="SW20" />

==History==
[[File:BrokenPowerMace-SW20.png|thumb|right|190px|Han Solo broke his power mace.]]
{{Quote|&mdash;some days you ''can't'' win!|Han Solo realizes his power mace is broken|<ref name="SW20" />}}
On a visit to [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] entered a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competition called [[the Big Game]] to win a cash prize that would enable him to pay off his debts to the station's administration. When Solo refused to give [[Unidentified Big Game administrator|one]] of the game officials the name of his preferred melee weapon, in protest over what he suspected to be tampering in the game's rankings, he was assigned a power mace and [[power shield]] for his first bout.<ref name="SW20" />

Solo faced a lumbering [[Living windmill|member]] of the [[Ultaarian Greenback]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who wielded [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[dagger thorn]]s. Solo's power mace appeared unable to harm the large opponent, and broke upon striking the creature's back. Solo then tripped the four-armed combatant with the energy shield, causing the hulking gladiator to fall upon a dagger thorn and [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="SW20" />

==Behind the scenes==
A power mace appears in [[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]], an issue of [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]]<ref name="SW20" /> published on [[February 1]], [[1979]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53810/star_wars_1977_20|text=Star Wars (1977) #20}}</ref> The issue was written by [[Archie Goodwin]], and illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]] and [[Bob Wiacek]].<ref name="SW20" />
